# Privacy Policy — Goblin Survey (哥布林大調查)

Status: DRAFT (policy-draft-2026-10-09). Mirrors the website page; the website renders the same source.

## 摘要（繁體中文）

- 目前網站只使用合成示範資料：沒有帳號登入、沒有 Riot 帳號連結、不收集任何訪客的遊戲資料。
- 未來若取得 Riot 正式核准（Production Key 與 RSO），才會在玩家主動連結並逐項同意後收集資料；預設全部拒絕，可隨時撤回。

## 1. Current status vs. future approved mode

CURRENT SYNTHETIC DEMO: this website shows fictional members and fictional matches generated by an offline fake data source. There is no sign-in, no Riot account linking, no form that collects personal data, and the website itself makes no request to Riot or any other game-data provider. The site is a static website hosted on GitHub Pages and loads only static files.

FUTURE APPROVED RSO MODE (not live): if Riot Games approves a Production API key and a Riot Sign On (RSO) client for this product, players will be able to link a Riot account through RSO and grant permissions as described below. Nothing in that mode is live today.

PRIVATE LOCAL EVALUATION DATA: during earlier development the operator collected match data for a small friend group through a third-party VALORANT API on the operator's own machine. That dataset is private, has never been published on this website, and is not used for any public page. Its members are treated as NOT having given product consent: they must re-consent explicitly before any of their data could be shown anywhere.

## 2. Data categories

The table distinguishes what exists today from what the approved mode would process.

- Website visitors (today): the site sets no cookies and runs no analytics. The hosting provider (GitHub) may process technical request data such as IP addresses under its own privacy statement.
- Product account data (future): a product user id and a display name.
- External identity references (future): a verified Riot account reference obtained through RSO, stored privately and never shown publicly.
- Consent metadata (future): the four permission states, policy version, and an append-only history of changes (who, when, previous and new state).
- Group and invite metadata (future): groups, memberships, roles, and invites (only a hash of each invite token is stored).
- Match / game data (future, only with Data Collection permission): VALORANT match history and match details of the linked account, obtained by a local worker from the official Riot API.
- Derived analytics (future): statistics computed from collected matches (for example per-member performance statistics, shared-match comparisons, historical team-fit). These are community statistics, not an official rank, MMR or Elo.
- Provider provenance (future): which source and software version produced a record, kept for accuracy and auditing; raw provider identifiers stay private.
- Audit and security metadata (future): security-relevant actions (for example consent changes, invite use, sync requests) recorded with ids and codes only — never tokens or account identifiers.

## 3. Purpose

Data would be processed only to provide invite-only groups of players with their own and group-permitted performance statistics, historical derived analytics, shared-match comparisons between members, and historical team-composition suggestions. It is not used for opponent scouting, advertising profiles, selling data, or building a global player database.

## 4. Opt-in and permissions

Linking a Riot account is optional and user-initiated. Being invited to or joining a group never grants any data access.

Permissions are separate and all OFF by default: Data Collection (may we fetch and store your match data), Group Visibility (may your group see your statistics), Public Derived Analytics (may derived statistics appear on a public group page). A verified account connection is a fact, not a permission. Player-specific statistics are never shown before you opt in.

## 5. Publication eligibility

Your derived statistics can appear in a public group snapshot only if your membership is active, the group is active, and you have granted Group Visibility and Public Derived Analytics (which also require Data Collection and a verified connection). Public pages never contain account identifiers, raw match ids, positions or view directions. Members who have not opted in do not appear in other members' comparisons either.

## 6. Retention

No fixed legal retention periods are promised yet; classes and rules are:

- Control-plane metadata (groups, memberships, invites): OPERATIONAL_NECESSITY.
- Consent history and audit records: OPERATIONAL_NECESSITY (needed to prove what was permitted); exact period TBD_WITH_POLICY_REVIEW.
- Provider identity reference: UNTIL_USER_REVOCATION (cleared when you unlink).
- Collected match evidence: UNTIL_USER_REVOCATION of Data Collection, subject to the deletion rules below; exact period TBD_WITH_POLICY_REVIEW.
- Derived analytics: recomputed from current evidence; removed from future publications when eligibility ends.
- Public snapshots: immutable static files; a new snapshot without your data replaces the active one after revocation; older files TBD_WITH_POLICY_REVIEW.
- Revocation records: OPERATIONAL_NECESSITY.

## 7. Revocation and deletion

These are different operations with different effects:

- Revoke Public Derived Analytics: you leave future public snapshots; collection may continue.
- Revoke Group Visibility: your group no longer sees your statistics; public eligibility also ends.
- Revoke Data Collection: future collection stops, public eligibility ends, and a data-revocation request is sent to the data store, which removes your player-attributable precise spatial evidence (positions and view directions). Shared, non-attributable match records involving other players are not instantly deleted.
- Disconnect your Riot account: the private account reference is cleared and every permission that depends on it is revoked as above.
- Leave a group (or be removed): you stop being eligible for that group's pages and syncs; it does not by itself delete data.
- Request deletion: email casper880115@gmail.com; handling of other stored records on request is planned and its exact process is TBD_WITH_POLICY_REVIEW.

## 8. Third-party services

Today: GitHub (website hosting). Future approved mode: Riot Games (Riot Sign On and the official VALORANT API) as the intended data source. A third-party VALORANT API was used only for private local evaluation and is not the planned public data backbone. Data is never sold.

## 9. Security

No API key or credential is ever placed in the website or the public repository. Public pages are built from an allowlist that rejects private fields. In the planned mode: provider account references stay private, invite tokens are stored only as hashes, permissions default to deny, security actions are audit-logged, and data collection runs on a local worker that only makes outbound HTTPS requests. No system is perfectly secure; known gaps are listed in the application package.

## 10. Contact

General, non-sensitive questions: the project's public issue tracker (https://github.com/scottpuppylu/valorant-squad-analytics-v2/issues). Do not post personal data there.

Private requests — privacy questions, data access, data deletion and consent questions: email casper880115@gmail.com.

## 11. Changes to this policy

Version policy-draft-2026-10-09 (2026-10-09). This is a draft prepared for the planned Riot application. Material changes will be shown on this page with a new version and date before they apply to collected data; permissions you granted under an older version are not silently extended.
